articles.title: 2 weeks left for Clarity: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: The Senate leaves town in two weeks. Here's what needs to happen for Clarity to advance before then.

articles.title: Senate Dems should accept the victory they won on Trump's crypto limits: White House
articles.snippet: U.S. Senate Democrats got President Donald Trump to accept potential limits on his lucrative crypto dealings, but they say the Clarity Act's restrictions aren't enough.

articles.title: Fidelity joins push for Senate passage of CLARITY Act
articles.snippet: Fidelity called on the US Senate to pass the CLARITY Act, joining industry groups and crypto firms pushing for market structure legislation.

articles.title: House passes bill on lawmakers using insider information for stock trading
articles.snippet: According to Senator Elizabeth Warren, the House bill “won’t solve the problem“ of insider trading in Congress as lawmakers will still be allowed to own and sell stocks.

articles.title: Clarity Act on the Ropes as Ethics Fight and Shrinking Calendar Threaten Passage
articles.snippet: Senate Majority Leader John Thune signals the crypto market-structure bill likely won't clear the chamber before the August recess, as Democrats reject the GOP's ethics language and analysts slash the odds of passage.
